children: HAMILTON, Bermuda, Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Paratus Energy Services Ltd. (ticker: PLSV) ("Paratus" or the "Company") will release its unaudited interim Q3 2026 financial results on 27 November 2026 at approximately 07:00 CET.

In connection with the results release, the Company will host a webcast to present the results at 15:00 CET on the same day. To participate in the webcast, please use the following link to register and access the live presentation:
The webcast and presentation materials will be accessible in the Investors section of the Company's website:
Baton Haxhimehmedi, CFO and Interim CEO

Paratus Energy Services Ltd. (ticker: PLSV) is an investment holding company with a 50% joint venture interest in Seagems. Seagems is a leading subsea services company that owns and operates a fleet of six multi-purpose pipe-laying support vessels, providing support, installation, flexible pipe-laying and construction services. All vessels are currently operating under contracts in Brazil.
